- Chibuotu Amadi, CEO and co-founder of Paycrest.
- Harshit Tiwari, VP of growth at the NEAR Foundation.
- Ronak Jethava, UAE head at Startale Group.

The organizer is still finalizing the session agenda.

### Passes and admission

- General includes both conference days, tea, coffee and snacks. Lunch is excluded.
- Priority adds the Fairmont lunch buffet on both days and eligibility to apply for the Institutional Forum.
- Priority + Tangem adds a three-card Tangem hardware wallet pack, with the two-day lunch buffet and eligibility to apply for the Institutional Forum.
- VIP includes Priority benefits and access to the Grand Terminus VIP Lounge. VIP Night access remains subject to confirmation.
- Executive VIP adds one night at Fairmont and dedicated airport transfers to the VIP benefits.
- Student includes General benefits, priority workshop access and hackathon eligibility.

The prices displayed on October 15 are ₹1,749 for General, ₹3,999 for Priority, ₹3,749 for Priority + Tangem, ₹29,999 for VIP, ₹59,999 for Executive VIP and ₹999 for Student, before applicable taxes. The site also flags an October 15 price increase; the organizer's checkout supplies the price payable when booking.

Every IBW2026 pass, including one already purchased, qualifies its holder to purchase a separate Devcon ticket for US$99 through October 25, 2026. The organizer sends the redemption code by email. Devcon admission requires that additional purchase.

Institutional Forum seats require a separate application and selection. Its application page asks Priority, VIP and Executive VIP holders to secure their conference pass before applying; the programming team reviews applications and emails its decision.

name: Binance Blockchain Week 2026
description:
Binance Blockchain Week (BBW) Bangkok 2026 is the flagship annual conference hosted by Binance at the Queen Sirikit National Convention Center (QSNCC) in Bangkok, Thailand, from 28 to 29 November 2026. The 2026 gathering convenes global Web3 founders, institutional allocators, core developers, regulators, and digital asset leaders under the headline theme EVOLVE.

## What to expect

Binance Blockchain Week 2026 explores how blockchain architecture, artificial intelligence, and global financial rails are converging into open, 24/7 onchain markets. Programming spans two primary stages:

- Main Stage: Keynotes, executive debates, and high-level macroeconomic discussions on institutional liquidity, sovereign stablecoins, regulatory compliance, and cross-border settlement.
- Innovation Stage: Technical presentations, interactive workshops, and project showcases focusing on decentralized infrastructure, zero-knowledge scalability, decentralized physical infrastructure (DePIN), and autonomous AI agent economies.

Attendees can also explore an expansive exhibition hall featuring interactive installations, ecosystem lounges, developer hubs, and live protocol demonstrations across BNB Chain and the broader multi-chain ecosystem.

## Side events and community week

Throughout the conference week in Bangkok, ecosystem teams host dozens of satellite gatherings across the city. Featured community meetups, technical hackathons, demo days, VIP networking banquets, and closing celebrations are scheduled across Sukhumvit, Silom, and riverside venues, linked under the official BBW calendar.

## Who should attend

Binance Blockchain Week is designed for crypto founders, protocol engineers, institutional traders, venture capital partners, DeFi builders, liquidity providers, and community members participating in the evolution of digital finance across Asia and globally.

## Venue and travel

The conference takes place at Queen Sirikit National Convention Center (QSNCC), 60 Ratchadaphisek Road, Khlong Toei, Bangkok. The venue offers direct underground connection via MRT Queen Sirikit National Convention Centre station (Exit 3), providing seamless transit access from central Bangkok hotels and Suvarnabhumi Airport (BKK). Registration passes and credential collection are managed through the official event portal.
location: Queen Sirikit National Convention Center (QSNCC), Bangkok, Thailand

Get ready for an unforgettable experience as Crypto Fest, hosted by Bitcoin Events, returns for its highly anticipated eighth edition, set against the breathtaking backdrop of Cape Town, South Africa!

As Cape Town's premier annual Web3 event, Crypto Fest brings together a diverse community of innovators, industry leaders, and blockchain enthusiasts to explore the rapidly evolving world of cryptocurrency, blockchain, and decentralized finance (DeFi).

This year's event features exclusive networking opportunities and sessions led by top industry experts, offering valuable insights into the latest trends shaping crypto, blockchain, Web3, and DeFi.
- Decentralised Intelligence: The Convergence of AI, Web3 & Data

Sub-Saharan Africa is the 3rd fastest-growing crypto region, per the 2025 report by Chainalysis.

From Jul 2024 to Jun 2025, it saw $205B in on-chain value, up 52% YoY. Nigeria led with $92.1B, nearly three times South Africa's. South Africa ranked second, helped by its clearer regulatory framework, while Ethiopia, Kenya, and Ghana rounded out the top five.

In 2024, South Africa took a major step by approving 248 Crypto Asset Service Provider (CASP) licences (as at December 2024). By December 2025, the FSCA had approved 300 CASPs out of 512 applications received (with 14 declined and 291 still active on the latest published list).

The Travel Rule for crypto asset transfers was implemented in South Africa via Financial Intelligence Centre Directive 9, effective 30 April 2025, aligning the country with international AML/CFT standards to combat financial crime.

As Africa continues to experience rapid growth in crypto adoption, Crypto Fest remains the premier platform to showcase regional and global trends, opportunities, and innovations shaping the future of Web3

Jack Mallers

Strike Jack Mallers is the Founder and CEO of Strike, the global Bitcoin app. Prior to Strike, Jack was one of the first application developers on top of Bitcoin's Lightning Network. Jack has spent the last decade of his life in the Bitcoin space, pioneering efforts in distributed systems infrastructure, architecture, and application development

Edward Snowden

Edward Snowden is a privacy advocate and former intelligence contractor whose 2013 disclosures revealed the scope of global government surveillance programs, sparking an international debate on privacy, security, and civil liberties. Since then, he has become a prominent voice on digital privacy, encryption, and the relationship between technology and individual freedom, contributing to discussions on the societal implications of surveillance in the digital age

Pierre Rochard

Pierre Rochard has researched and written about Bitcoin since 2013. He co-founded the Satoshi Nakamoto Institute in 2014 to curate the best primary source literature. In addition to developing open-source Bitcoin software, Pierre is an outspoken advocate for Bitcoin's decentralized governance. He co-hosts the Noded Bitcoin Podcast and the Bitcoin for Advisors Podcast. Pierre served as the Bitcoin and Lightning product manager at Kraken for three years before joining Riot as the VP of Research

Obi Nwosu

Obi Nwosu is cofounder and CEO of Fedi and a zealous advocate for Bitcoin mass adoption. He previously founded the Bitcoin exchange Coinfloor, and holds board positions at ₿trust and Gridless Comput

Adam Back

Co-founder and CEO of Blockstream, Dr. Adam Back, invented Hashcash, the proof-of-work algorithm cited by Satoshi Nakamoto in the Bitcoin whitepaper, as the future basis for its mining function. Throughout his two-decade-long vocation as an applied cryptographer and security architect, he has held senior roles with a number of technology companies, including Microsoft, EMC, PI, VMware, and Zero-Knowledge Systems, as well as advised many more companies on cryptography and peer-to-peer finance. Dr. Adam Back holds a computer science Ph.D. in distributed systems from the University of Exeter

Elizabeth Stark

Elizabeth Stark is CEO and Founder of Lightning Labs, where she is building a programmable financial layer for the internet with fast, scalable bitcoin transactions

Joana Cotar

Independent Member of the German Parliament. Founder of the ""Bitcoin im Bundestag"" initiative. The initiative is committed to raising awareness and educating members of the German Bundestag about Bitcoin. It aims to ensure that political decision-makers are always up to date and can adequately consider the impact of Bitcoin on society

Ben Arc

Ben Arc is a developer, educator, and open-source contributor focused on improving Bitcoin's usability through Lightning Network tools and self-custody solutions. He is best known for creating and maintaining projects such as LNbits, which help individuals and businesses build on Bitcoin with accessible, open-source infrastructure. Ben is an active advocate for decentralized technologies, privacy, and expanding practical Bitcoin adoption around the world

description: Vivek Raman is the Co-Founder and CEO of Etherealize, where he is building the global settlement network for tokenized assets on Ethereum. Etherealize is the only company ever funded by the Ethereum Foundation to serve as its institutional arm, and is backed by Paradigm, Electric Capital, and Vitalik Buterin. Prior to founding Etherealize, Vivek spent fifteen years on Wall Street and in digital assets. He traded high-yield bonds, distressed credit, leveraged loans, and credit default swaps at Morgan Stanley, UBS, Deutsche Bank, and Nomura. He went on to serve as Managing Director and Head of Digital Assets at BitOoda, a regulated digital asset investment bank, and built a real estate portfolio of 100+ homes and land parcels - where the industry’s inefficiency drove his interest in blockchain. In June 2025, Vivek testified before the U.S. House Financial Services Committee in support of the CLARITY Act, making the case that decentralized blockchain networks represent critical infrastructure for the next generation of American capital markets. He has also engaged directly with the SEC's Crypto Task Force and serves on the CFTC's Industry Advisory Committee on the regulatory framework for tokenized assets. At Etherealize, Vivek has assembled a team of over thirty spanning Wall Street veterans and Ethereum's most accomplished engineers and has raised $40 million to bring institutional assets fully on-chain. He is a graduate of Yale University, where he studied economics.

India Blockchain & AI Tour 2026 is the fifth edition of Octaloop's multi-city event series for blockchain and AI developers, founders, investors and enterprise teams. The tour runs across ten Indian cities from September 26 to November 22.

Metamorphosis in Hyderabad is the tour's two-day flagship event on September 26-27. Its announced program includes investor roundtables and a Founder Demo Day.

description:
Octaloop hosts the Mumbai edition of the India Blockchain & AI Tour 2026 on Friday, October 31, from 10:00 to 17:00 IST. The day-long conference explores the intersection of decentralized technology, machine learning, and digital public infrastructure in India

What to expect

The summit features keynote presentations, panel sessions, and technical product showcases:
- High-level panels examining the convergence of decentralized computing, decentralized physical infrastructure (DePIN), and sovereign AI.
- Architecture sessions covering AI agent coordination on EVM chains, zero-knowledge inference, and cryptographic verification for autonomous models.
- Institutional discussions on regulatory policy, digital asset compliance, and Web3 enterprise integration in Bharat.
- Networking breaks, sponsor exhibitions, and executive roundtables connecting founders with venture capital funds

Who should attend

The event is designed for software engineers, blockchain architects, AI researchers, Web3 founders, enterprise technology executives, and angel investors active in the Indian tech ecosystem

Venue and schedule

The conference takes place at a premier hospitality auditorium in Mumbai on Friday, October 31, 2026, running from 10:00 to 17:00 IST

Registration and admission

Tickets and registration passes are available through the official India Blockchain Tour portal. Early registration is recommended to guarantee admission and access to conference recordings.

Chandigarh is a listed stop on Octaloop's India Blockchain & AI Tour 2026. The fifth edition of the tour focuses on Web3 and AI communities across India, including developers, founders, investors and enterprise participants. The linked city page currently returns the general tour site. Confirm Chandigarh's venue, hours and admission details through the organizer; the tour overview is not a city-specific agenda.

## About the tour

India Blockchain & AI Tour 2026 is the fifth edition of the India Blockchain & AI Tour - Octaloop's most ambitious journey through the heart of the world's fastest-growing Web3 economy. As the global spotlight turns to India for Devcon 2026, the tour returns to 10 cities to bridge the gap between global innovation and local grassroots talent. It is the biggest year yet, designed to connect 15,000+ builders, founders, and leaders across Tier 1 and Tier 2 hubs - not just a set of events, but a distribution layer for the Indian ecosystem.

## Why attend
Architect networking: with 65%+ decision-maker attendance, IBT is where global protocol founders meet India's institutional capital.
Market penetration: bridge the gap between global tech and India's 500M+ digital natives across 10 strategic cities.
Talent integration: engage with the world's densest pool of Ethereum, Solana, and Polygon developers via curated talent showcases.
Elite VIP access: from private HNI dinners to exclusive Whale Lounges, experience the highest tier of Indian business hospitality.

## Flagship event

The IBT26 flagship event is Metamorphosis Hyderabad. Metamorphosis is the crown jewel of the India Blockchain Tour: a high-impact convergence of global protocols and India's leading AI x Web3 innovators. Over two days in Hyderabad, the program moves beyond panels to outcomes - from curated investor roundtables to the Founder Demo Day, this is where the industry's next $100M ideas get mapped out.

## Who should attend
Founders & CXOs: connect with global protocols and local venture capital to turn an MVP into a market leader.
Institutional investors: access a high-density pool of vetted Web3 startups and the developers behind India's most successful dApps.
Global ecosystems: deploy a GTM strategy across 10 strategic nodes and integrate with the world's largest Web3 workforce.
Policy & enterprise: engage with regulators and industry titans to lead the institutional adoption of blockchain in Bharat.

name: Zcash Presents: FREE SOCIETY HACKATHON
description:
WebZero Events and Zcash host Free Society Hackathon at True Tramm Trunk BKC in Mumbai on 4 and 5 November 2026, during Devcon. The organizers are selecting 75 in-person builders to develop working products using Zcash, with an Agentic Commerce track from Bitrefill

Who can take part

Engineers, developers, product people, marketers and founders can apply, including people without a technical background or prior Zcash experience. The program starts with a tooling walkthrough, and mentors from Zcash projects provide workshops and one-to-one guidance throughout the build day.

Teams can have one to four people. Bring a team or find teammates at the venue. A project can enter both tracks if it meets each track's requirements

Tracks and prizes

The organizers advertise USD 5,000 in cash prizes. The published breakdown includes USD 4,800 in competition awards and USD 200 in conditional follow-up bonuses:

- The Zcash Privacy track awards USD 1,300 to the top project, two second prizes of USD 300 each and two third prizes of USD 200 each, totaling USD 2,300 across five projects.
- The Bitrefill Agentic Commerce track requires projects to use Bitrefill. It offers USD 1,000 for the most innovative project, USD 800 for second place, USD 600 for third and USD 100 for the best feedback, totaling USD 2,500.

Both USD 300 Privacy track winners are also named Zcash Ecosystem Prize winners. Each can earn a further USD 100 by agreeing on a milestone relevant to their submission and delivering it publicly. Those two milestone-dependent bonuses account for the remaining USD 200 in the advertised total

Schedule

All times are IST (Asia/Kolkata). Luma lists the event from 11:00 on Wednesday 4 November to 15:00 on Thursday 5 November 2026.

Wednesday 4 November is the hack day:
- : welcome and tooling walkthrough.
- : building begins, with workshops and mentors.
- Midnight at the end of hack day, listed as 00:00: submissions close.

Judges score every project overnight and select the teams that will demo on stage.

Thursday 5 November is demo day:
- : top teams announced.
- : demos and winners announced on stage

Food and facilities

Breakfast, lunch and dinner on hack day, plus an afterparty, are included. The venue provides hacking areas, fast internet and group seating. The organizers also advertise merchandise and describe the location as a short tuk-tuk ride from the main Devcon venue

After the hackathon

Winning teams will be paired with an ecosystem partner to agree, deliver and publicly share one small milestone within 30 days, with mentorship and support. The organizers say the same milestone-based follow-up is open to builders who do not win

Registration and venue

The Hacker Pass is free, but registration requires host approval. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis for the 75 selected places. Participants must be in Mumbai in person on Wednesday 4 November; remote participation is not available.

The public venue is True Tramm Trunk BKC, G2-B, Ground Floor, Trade Centre Bkc, opposite MTNL, G Block, MMRDA Area, Bandra Kurla Complex, Bandra East, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400098, India.

description:

The residency brings scientists, engineers, cryptographers, developers and community organizers together to build prototypes. The organizer's page specifies the October dates; the Devcon 8 calendar supplies the 2026 year. No daily start or finish time has been confirmed.

The program selects 30 residents. Scholarships cover eight nights of accommodation, food and drinks, on-site activities and the closing summit on October 30. Applicants can request domestic travel assistance. Rooms are shared, with five to seven people in single-sex rooms. The published application window was September 11 to 26.

Participants choose among the Logos Civic Prize, Logos Sovereignty and Privacy, Zu-Grama d/acc, and a non-builder track for activists, community organizers and artists. Technical work includes privacy-preserving blockchain, decentralized governance, censorship-resistant storage and secure payments. Creatives, designers and testers can also apply.

The schedule includes stand-ups, mentoring, dedicated build time, workshops and demos. Residents present prototypes at the closing summit. The strongest Logos-track prototypes are eligible for milestone-based grant funding. Applicants are asked to install Logos Basecamp, add its blockchain module and note the block height; an existing demo or prototype is helpful but not required.

"Connecting the Nodes Beyond the Screen" is not just a slogan. it is a commitment for the future. At WebX, every industry, company, and individual is connected beyond digital boundaries, like nodes connected in blockchains, transforming the world through the power of advanced technology. WebX is also the only conference where attendees can interact with a broad spectrum of government organizations, established companies, IP companies, and Web3 companies.
